name: How long does a typical rental property restoration project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical rental property restoration project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a rental property restoration project varies significantly based on the extent of damage and the scope of work. Minor cosmetic updates might take a few days to a week. Extensive renovations involving structural repairs, multiple room overhauls, or addressing issues like water damage could take several weeks to a few months. A general contractor can provide a more accurate timeline after assessing the specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies. Minor work can be days, while extensive renovations may take weeks to months, depending on damage and scope.
